title: Florida House, District 68
what_it_does: Represents District 68 (Part of Hillsborough) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings.

candidates.name: Ryan Gill
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Sixth-generation Floridian who runs his family's cattle ranch in southeast Hillsborough County, land the family has worked for over 120 years. He was Farm Credit Agriculturalist of the Year in 2022 and serves on the Hillsborough County Cattlemen's Association board. Married with four children. His website lists no issue positions.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

taxes.summary: Gill said he would cut the cost of living by reducing insurance, energy and tax burdens and red tape, and would make government live within its means so families keep more of their paychecks.
taxes.quote: Make government live within its means so working families keep more of their paycheck.

sources.title: 2026 Florida election candidates: Midterm voter guide (Tampa Bay Times)

property_tax.summary: Asked what he would do about the cost of living, Gill said he would cut property insurance and property tax.
property_tax.quote: Cut property insurance and property tax.

sources.title: 2026 Florida election candidates: Midterm voter guide (Tampa Bay Times)

guns.summary: Gill listed defending the Second Amendment, along with parental rights and constitutional limits on government, among his three top priorities.
guns.quote: Back law enforcement, secure communities and defend parental rights, the Second Amendment and constitutional limits on government.

sources.title: 2026 Florida election candidates: Midterm voter guide (Tampa Bay Times)

healthcare.summary: Gill said Medicaid and health spending should center on children, eliminating the waitlist for Floridians with disabilities and extending benefits for new mothers, which he said protects the state budget; he did not back expansion.

sources.title: 2026 Florida election candidates: Midterm voter guide (Tampa Bay Times)

growth.summary: Gill's answers point both ways: he says data centers should be stopped from draining water and paving over farmland and that 'water and land come first,' while also saying he is running to stop government from overregulating landowners and farmers and wants 'targeted yes, blanket no' rules.

sources.title: 2026 Florida election candidates: Midterm voter guide (Tampa Bay Times)

environment.summary: Gill, a former chair of the Hillsborough Soil and Water Conservation District, said water and land come first and that data centers should be stopped from draining the state's water and paving over farmland.
environment.quote: As a rancher and former Soil and Water chairman, water and land come first.

sources.title: 2026 Florida election candidates: Midterm voter guide (Tampa Bay Times)

other_issues.title: Affordability and the next generation
other_issues.summary: In a statement issued with the Associated Industries of Florida endorsement, Gill said his family's long history on the same land taught him about 'preserving opportunity for the next generation' and that in Tallahassee he would work 'to make Florida more affordable.' He named no specific policies.

sources.title: AIF Endorses Ryan Gill for Florida House District 68
Associated Industries of Florida Endorses Ryan Gill in HD 68 Bid

other_issues.title: No issue positions published
other_issues.summary: Gill's campaign website carries only a biography and a contact form, with no issues page. The VOTE411 guide for State Representative 68 records 'Candidate has not yet responded' for him on all seven questions.

sources.title: Ryan Gill for State Representative District 68 - campaign website
VOTE411 Voter Guide: State Representative 68 (League of Women Voters of Florida)

other_issues.title: AI disclosure and foreign firms
other_issues.summary: Gill said Florida should require disclosure when AI is used in politics and commerce, protect children from companion chatbots, and block Chinese-tied firms from critical infrastructure.

sources.title: 2026 Florida election candidates: Midterm voter guide (Tampa Bay Times)

record.item: Elected to the Hillsborough County Soil and Water Conservation District, where he served two years as chairman; named Farm Credit Agriculturalist of the Year in 2022 and Plant City Chamber of Commerce Emerging Leader in 2023.

sources.title: Ryan Gill for State Representative District 68 - campaign website
AIF Endorses Ryan Gill for Florida House District 68
Florida Realtors PAC 2026 Endorsed Candidates

candidates.name: Tony Smith
candidates.occupation: Former Tampa Fire Rescue firefighter and Hillsborough County Public Schools EMT
candidates.background: Former firefighter with Tampa Fire Rescue and emergency medical technician with Hillsborough County Public Schools. He ran for Plant City Commission in 2026, losing a May 26 runoff 53-47 percent. No campaign website or issue statements were found.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

growth.summary: Smith's District 68 campaign site lists 'managing responsible growth' among four priorities, saying development should be matched with roads, schools, utilities and infrastructure before new expansion is approved.
growth.quote: ensuring development is matched with the roads, schools, utilities, and infrastructure our communities need before approving new expansion

sources.title: Tony B. Smith for Florida State Representative, District 68 - campaign website

crime.summary: His site lists public safety as a priority, saying he would support first responders, invest in crime prevention and stand behind law enforcement and firefighters. He does not address criminal penalties or sentencing.
crime.quote: Keeping our communities safe by supporting first responders, investing in crime prevention, and standing behind law enforcement and firefighters.

sources.title: Tony B. Smith for Florida State Representative, District 68 - campaign website

healthcare.summary: Smith said Florida should expand Medicaid, with a focus on preventive care, reducing fraud and stronger drug and insurance negotiations.
healthcare.quote: At this time, I believe we should expand Medicaid.

sources.title: 2026 Florida election candidates: Midterm voter guide (Tampa Bay Times)

energy.summary: Smith said he would start with stronger regulation of TECO's pricing practices, is open to bringing in additional energy companies to increase competition, and would explore solar and wind power, especially for public buildings.
energy.quote: I would begin with stronger regulation of TECO's pricing practices.

sources.title: 2026 Florida election candidates: Midterm voter guide (Tampa Bay Times)

housing.summary: Smith listed access to affordable housing among the everyday costs he would address for working families.

sources.title: 2026 Florida election candidates: Midterm voter guide (Tampa Bay Times)

other_issues.title: Affordability and infrastructure
other_issues.summary: The other two priorities on his site are lowering costs for working families and supporting small businesses, and improving transportation and addressing flooding in District 68.

sources.title: Tony B. Smith for Florida State Representative, District 68 - campaign website

other_issues.title: Did not answer the League of Women Voters questionnaire
other_issues.summary: The VOTE411 guide for State Representative 68 lists Smith's website and Facebook page and records 'Candidate has not yet responded' for all seven questions.

sources.title: VOTE411 Voter Guide: State Representative 68 (League of Women Voters of Florida)

other_issues.title: Flock cameras and a reading program
other_issues.summary: Smith called for responsible oversight of Flock cameras alongside fully funded police and fire services, and said he would use a $1 million appropriation to create a 'Level Up' program providing tutoring for elementary students reading below grade level.

sources.title: 2026 Florida election candidates: Midterm voter guide (Tampa Bay Times)

record.item: Ran for Plant City Commission Group 3 in 2026 and lost the May 26 runoff to Karen Kerr, 53% to 47%.

sources.title: Two new city commissioners are elected in Plant City

record.item: Serves on the City of Plant City Board of Adjustment and founded M.A.T.E.S., a community wellness initiative, in 2018.

sources.title: Tony B. Smith for Florida State Representative, District 68 - campaign website
